status: Cold payload fusion implemented; extended measurement and final current-source acceptance remain open.

mechanism.before: Initial wire lengths, includeInContext:false continuation lengths and estimator-keyed token facts occupied separate registrations and traversed normalized payloads separately.
mechanism.mapping: The existing fillMistralFormat uses readRowIds and plannedFromIds. It scans header/id pieces before normalized conversion so future claims and collisions are resolved before provider mapping. It does not require full ROW payload conversion. This dependency remains in place.
mechanism.after: Mistral preparation captures the default runtime estimator identity before registration. One registration computes wire length, both kept/stripped token contributions and a typed additive continuation byte contribution while each normalized unit is available. Subsequent mandatory estimation registers the identical settings/estimator key. Continuation planning derives from the already selected summary rather than registering another format or remeasuring pending holders.
mechanism.converter: The omitted contribution invokes factsOf with includeInContext:false on the original unit, not removeThinkingFromContent. Thinking-only messages, reasoning value fields and strict tool-format behavior therefore retain their converter semantics. allButLast selection composes the contribution only for kept units.
mechanism.schema: The 296-byte summary width is unchanged. Chat summary rank revision 2 assigns bytes 284..291 to an explicit uint64 omittedReasoningBytes contribution; bytes 292..295 remain zero. Journal file version advances from 9 to 10 and rejects CRC-valid version 9 files. Existing token and transfer-table slots are not repurposed.
mechanism.atomicity: Mapping, LENS and summary facts still publish through the existing single commit-group fill transaction. No new core provider import, publication path, request spool, operation file, all-unit array or history-sized cache was introduced. Dedicated new concurrent-fill/partial-failure mutation controls are not yet executed.
mechanism.warmReadCorrection: Fewer records placed short metadata VALUE records next to LENS records. The existing 1024-byte VALUE head prefetch crossed those record boundaries, producing four warm ROW/LENS overlaps. KeyedMapReader now reads the exact frame head and kind header before streaming its value body, rather than speculatively reading neighboring records. Assertions and read bounds are unchanged.

performanceRed.meaning: Actual prepareRequest, mandatory estimate and captured continuation pass independent legacy body/token oracles, then fail the physical payload-end read bound: 120/1200/12000 versus 40/400/4000 allowed.
